correctness.rationale: Every vertex of a part sees identical external neighbors. From any microstate a monochromatic-by-part corner has positive one-step probability. Direct examination of all 8 corners by the three order types of the part sizes leads, with positive probability, to exactly the displayed closed classes; direct updates prove closure and communication. The tied-largest class swaps its two large parts and redraws each small vertex independently, proving period 2, the uniform stationary law, and \(a(a+c)\) discordant edges. A finite chain in which every state can reach the listed closed classes has no further recurrent components. Standard-library verifier independently checked 216 macro and 27 full-micro parameter triples plus 104 exact small-part redraw/cut examples. This finite support verification corroborates rather than substitutes for the all-size proof.

value.rationale: It is a complete structural classification for every finite complete tripartite graph under the source stochastic majority rule. It distinguishes unique-largest deterministic polarization, two-largest phase-locked exponential random recurrence with exact uniform stationary distribution and invariant edge disagreement, and all-equal almost-sure consensus. The dependence on equality of population sizes is a natural sharp phase boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice or a computation-only census.
